The '''Swift blade''' is a [[Weapon slot table|one-handed weapon]] purchased from [[Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing]] for 350 [[Last Man Standing]] points.

It is one of the only four [[melee]] weapons with an [[attack speed]] of 3, with the other ones being the [[ham joint]], [[goblin paint cannon]], and [[mystic cards]], with the latter two also being two handed weapons only. The swift blade also exclusively uses [[Stab]] and [[Slash]] attack styles whereas the others use [[Crush]], and the mystic cards have negative combat stat bonuses whereas the others have no bonuses.

Due to having no [[Attack]] level requirement, the Swift blade is the best-in-slot weapon for training [[Defence pure]]s and combines well with the stab bonus given by the [[Ardougne cloak]]s.

This item is also commonly used in the [[Theatre of Blood]] for the [[Theatre_of_Blood/Strategies#Nylocas_Vasilias|Nylocas]] room because of its fast attack speed. It is preferred over the Goblin paint cannon and the Ham joint because its attack styles are not shared with the [[dragon warhammer]], allowing players to keep the dragon warhammer on an accurate attack style, while having the swift blade on an aggressive style. In addition, the swift blade is slightly more accurate than a ham joint when used with a [[defender]], as defenders have +2 higher stab accuracy compared to crush.
